front: Conjure a wooden ladder or spiral staircase, up to 40 feet tall, that stands freely or against a wall and supports itself in the air.
back:
Choose the height when casting, max 40 feet. The ladder (simple, discreet) or spiral staircase (easier to climb, more conspicuous) is wooden, locked in place and magically supported, even in open air.
Both can be damaged and destroyed as normal.
You can Dismiss the spell.
Heightened (+1): max height increases by 40 feet.
